description:
Perform a data compliance cleanup by purging old visitor records. 

1. First, import the historical data file located at '/home/ga/Desktop/legacy_visitor_log.csv' into the visitor database to simulate restoring a backup.
2. Once imported, identify and permanently delete ALL visitor records with a visit date PRIOR to January 1, 2023 (records from 2022 and earlier).
3. Preserve all records from January 1, 2023, onwards.
4. Finally, export the remaining (cleaned) visitor log to a CSV file named 'audit_proof.csv' located in '/home/ga/Documents/'.
